name: hoa
description: Palm Grove Community Association, Inc. (fictional) HOA books: transfers between the operating and reserve accounts, the adopted operating budget, operating-account expenses, and owner assessments. Synthetic demo data; all money in integer cents. No unit-owner PII is exposed; the controls work from unit, line and transfer IDs only.
domain: HOA board review: reserve transfers, operating budget vs actual, and delinquent assessments
notes: A transfer OUT of the reserve account (from_account = 'RESERVE') needs prior written board approval on record (California Civil Code s 5502); board_approval_id is the approving minutes reference. A transfer INTO reserve needs no approval, so a null board_approval_id on such a row is not a finding.

budget-variance is per operating line: actual spending is the sum of operating_expenses for the line, and a line whose spending exceeds its adopted_cents is an overspend. Pass the fiscal_year to scope it.

delinquent-assessments ages unpaid assessments (paid_date is null) against the latest due_date in the table as 'today'; a days_past_due parameter (default 60) sets the aging threshold. Thresholds vary by association and state.
The resident_pii table (unit-owner names, emails and phone numbers) is intentionally omitted: this engine never reads resident PII. The controls identify owners by unit ID only.
